exact_exception: PermissionError: [WinError 5] Access denied during os.replace(input.xyz.tmp -> input.xyz)
root_cause: The frozen reference0 conformer is intentionally duplicated for each molecule's two record IDs. Both rows therefore share the same xTB identity and cache/work directory. ThreadPool workers submitted both concurrently and raced while atomically replacing the same input.xyz.
repair: Deduplicate tasks by frozen identity_sha256, execute every unique scientific identity once, and fan the immutable xTB result back out to both frozen record IDs.
